description: Renovate is the one dependency bot here. Every pull request it opens that only moves pins is approved and merged by .github/workflows/bot-merge.yml once CI passes, so pins do not wait for a person.

Pins stay pins: actions by commit hash with the version in a comment, images by digest. tests/static/50-supply-chain.sh and tests/static/10-bootstrap-not-circular.sh fail a pull request that turns one back into a tag.

packageRules.description: Actions move weekly in one pull request, and only to a release at least three days old, so a release that is pulled or hijacked upstream has time to be noticed before it lands here.

customManagers.description: An image run from a workflow step, pinned by digest under a '# tag: <tag>' marker. scripts/check-image-pins reads the same marker.
